content: We randomly sampled 5,000 articles from each quality class and removed all redirect pages, resulting in a dataset of 29,794 articles. As the wikitext contained in each document contains markup relating to the document category such as {Featured Article} or {geo-stub}, which reveals the label, we remove such information. We additionally randomly partitioned this dataset into training, development, and test splits based on a ratio of 8:1:1. Details of the dataset are summarized in Table 1 .
